checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-robotdocs.XXXXXX); (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); "$tmp/ao" robot-docs --help >"$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'Print the paste-ready agent handbook for the ao CLI (Markdown)' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'Print a paste-ready, agent-targeted handbook for the whole ao CLI' "$tmp/help"; "$tmp/ao" robot-docs >"$tmp/text"; grep -Fq '# ao — Agent Handbook' "$tmp/text"; grep -Fq '## Output contract' "$tmp/text"; grep -Fq '## Command surface' "$tmp/text"; grep -Fq 'Run `ao <command> --help` for the flags and arguments of any command.' "$tmp/text"

aliases.reason: The robotdocs family declares no command aliases.

rejected_args.reason: robot-docs accepts arbitrary positional args and rejects none.

stderr.reason: robot-docs writes only to stdout on success.

tracker_selection.reason: The robotdocs family does not select a repository issue tracker.

ordered_effects.reason: robot-docs is a pure render of the live command tree with no ordered effects.
